entry_matrix.flow: Requires valid Assist mapping and owner. stop/disconnect retires server before wanted/publish; an independent subscriber cannot bootstrap it.
entry_matrix.finding: Static causal link, Runtime physical execution modeled in lifecycle fixture.

entry_matrix.finding: No additional defect proved. Deliberate fatal hide/initial-frame timeout autoPaused state requires reenable or target exit; do not label this as infinite recovery failure.

entry_matrix.flow: Enabled or own secondaryEnabled causes discovery and latest-worker submission. Result acceptance checks generation, PID, process connection and sample age.
entry_matrix.finding: No Assist producer dependency. SamplingTask private ReadSession uses ordinary RPM until an explicit WorldFrameScope is entered; no such scope in this module.

entry_matrix.flow: Primary requires enabled + requested + foreground; secondary has independent request/monitor gate. Sampling needs valid world identity and shared scene provider. New PID/match invalidates worker results and rebinds tracks.
entry_matrix.finding: Affected by confirmed paused producer loss in pre.5; no separate worker permanent latch proved.

entry_matrix.flow: Called from common paint after valid display/world ownership. Shared source is a consumer, not an independent Runtime bootstrap.
entry_matrix.finding: Affected by confirmed paused producer loss when secondary requested. No renderer internals audited.

entry_matrix.flow: Requested render/overlay/counter demand also requires enabled, game foreground, live PID/window and compatible display. Hidden/disabled suspends scene and compositor workers. Renderer opt-ins remain availability-gated separately by frontend.
entry_matrix.finding: Pause hiding the main game overlay is intentional. No promise of independent paused main renderer; no raster/GPU algorithm audit.

entry_matrix.flow: Each client has a lease and enabled bit; releasing Assist while Cursor remains leaves Cursor only. Pending broker/old target retirement must finish before reuse. Shared world channel is bound to game PID + Host owner + connection.
entry_matrix.finding: Static review plus preexisting broker recovery research; no additional lifetime lock proved in this pass.

new_readonly_design: Assist protocol 103 appends readOnly/readOnlyRequest/readOnlyAck. Old paired DLL rejected by identity/version check.
Host maintains producer heartbeat/frame sampling while it clears command, selection, pointer, planner and pending UI input.
Runtime retires owned features, terminally cancels all request sources and mailboxes, publishes a cleanup ACK, then only captures the existing immutable world source.
Ordinary admission cannot resume before matching readOnlyRequest/ACK. Same-world calculation placement stays latched; a world first seen read-only applies pending config on first command entry.
runtime_tests: Final execution is being recorded at lifecycle/integration-final/result.json and lifecycle/unit-final/result.json. Each negative control states its exact historical or development-fixture provenance. Controlled execution is not a live-game repair confirmation.
boundaries: No native Windows hooks, actual game sessions, GPU output, pixels, FPS or multiplayer execution.
Standalone UnitMonitor deliberately retains private external reads; it was not migrated to shared world sampling.
Display freshness, active command readiness and function availability are distinct. Shared healthy connection does not prove input delivery or every worker result.
No current live user session proves the paused-secondary defect caused the originally reported all-hotkeys failure.

new_implementation_cross_review.origin: Introduced risk while implementing persistent read-only mapping in pre.6; pre.5 releaseBridge retired the mapping. Frozen pre-cancellation helper is a development intermediate, not a released pre.5 defect.
new_implementation_cross_review.resolution: Retire shared cooperativeRequest under cooperativeSeq, retain clickSerial, validate exact old/current consumer.

new_implementation_cross_review.issue: single-player FPS can reopen itself during readonly retirement
new_implementation_cross_review.origin: Interaction created by new pre.6 read-only mode with the existing fresh/maintain path. Pre.5 lacked this protocol mode; do not attribute a nonexistent readOnly field defect to pre.5.
new_implementation_cross_review.resolution: Actual fresh callback and maintenance reject readonly/awaiting ACK/Runtime active fence; old pre.5 fresh source is a controlled comparison under new conditions.

new_implementation_cross_review.issue: owned input release lost during readonly transition or immediate resume
new_implementation_cross_review.origin: Cross-review of newly introduced pre.6 readonly input early-return; fixed negative fixture is an explicitly documented development intermediate.
new_implementation_cross_review.resolution: Record only actually swallowed physical DOWN, retain ownership until matching release or proven new DOWN; normal action owners retain first decision after resume.

new_implementation_cross_review.issue: first command epoch initialization after a readonly-only world
new_implementation_cross_review.origin: New pre.6 read-only world observer can consume an epoch transition before normal command startup.
new_implementation_cross_review.resolution: Separate commandComputeEpoch initializes only the first ordinary entry of that epoch; same-epoch pause keeps next-match-only settings unchanged.
